name: centre-deck-walk-nameboard-midday
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,r=C.waterfrontIslandArrivals,E=C.ISLAND_ARRIVAL_ESTIMATES;const d=r.layout.docks.centre;const x=d.deckAnchor[0],z=d.deckAnchor[1];a.selectMode('person');a.teleportTo(x,z,0);const g=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,'person');if(!(Math.abs(g-E.deckTop)<0.05))throw Error('centre walker ground '+g+' != deck '+E.deckTop);const s=C.islandArrivalSurfaceAt(x,z);if(!s||s.dockId!=='centre')throw Error('centre surface sampler mismatch');const f=d.boardFacing;a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[x+f[0]*7,E.deckTop+1.55,z+f[1]*7],look:[x,E.deckTop+1.85,z],fov:50});return {dock:'centre',teleportGround:g,deckTop:E.deckTop,boardFacing:f};})()
